attempts.summary: Configured persistent Apache name-based hosting on node1: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP 8080, unknown hosts receive HTTP 403, tenant trees remain isolated, and all approved content is preserved. SELinux remains enforcing and firewalld remains active. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were retained.
